description.zh:
Owner的用户ID，多个用户ID用逗号分开。可通过调用接口[GetUser](~~147098~~)或[ListUsers](~~141938~~)获取UserId的值。
>用户ID的参数名为UserId。
description.en:
User IDs of the owners. Separate multiple user IDs with commas. You can obtain the value of UserId by invoking the [GetUser](~~147098~~) or [ListUsers](~~141938~~) API.
> The parameter name for User ID is UserId.

description.zh: 父类目的类目 ID。在此父类目下创建新类目，此值为空时创建一级类目。
description.en: The ID of the parent category. The new category is created under this parent category. If this value is left empty, the new category is of the first level.

description.zh: 租户ID。可通过调用[GetUserActiveTenant](~~198073~~)或[ListUserTenants](~~198074~~)接口获取该参数的值。
description.en: The ID of the tenant. You can call the [GetUserActiveTenant](~~198073~~) or [ListUserTenants](~~198074~~) operation to obtain the tenant ID.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun dms-enterprise create-meta-category --tid 3000 --name default --parent-category-id 30000322682 --description test --remark 21212 --owner-ids 510000 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun dms-enterprise CreateMetaCategory --region cn-hangzhou --Description test --Tid 3000 --ParentCategoryId 30000322682 --OwnerIds '[510000]' --Name default --Remark 21212
